verdict.rationale: The probe confirms angular.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured table of contents, and angular.dev also advertises 'AI-forward resources and integrations' (angular-docs-4), directly enabling an agent to be pointed at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt successfully, and no detail on how comprehensive/well-maintained the llms.txt content is beyond the header.
